---
title: "Signum Thermostat System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y\\
\dot{y} &=& -x+a sign(z)y\\
\dot{z} &=& y^2-1
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-2$ and initial condition $(1,-2,0)$.
